kpi.note: Targets and actuals the operator owes the district under the joint venture (JVA Sec. 5.1.5), as reported by COA. All six are district-wide totals; none says which barangays received how many hours, at what pressure.
kpi.cite: COA 2022 report Obs. 7, Table 6; COA 2024 Annual Audit Report Obs. 6, Table 6

complaints.note: Valid complaints logged by the operator, as reported by COA. The 2023 total is as restated in the 2024 report (the 2023 report said 1,125); the 2022 total is reported inconsistently across reports.
complaints.cite: COA 2022 Obs. 8.5; COA 2023 Obs. 8.5; COA 2024 Annual Audit Report Obs. 9.6, p. 53

findings: COA found the district compliant with its Water Safety Plan in 2024, and in the same observation reported 1,490 complaints, up 20.75% from 2023.
The operator served 22 barangays each year from 2022 to 2024, short of its target of 23 (2022) and 24 (2023, 2024). COA does not name the barangays left out.
The rewards and penalties framework the joint venture calls for (Sec. 8.5.4) was still not finalized in 2024, five years in.
The 6% performance bond was not forfeited in any year, though 1 to 2 of 6 targets were missed each year from 2022 to 2024.
In 2024, 135 of 170 operator capital projects (₱125.0M) had no supporting documents.
10 of 15 prior-year COA recommendations had not been implemented as of 2024.
findingsCite: Author's extract of COA Annual Audit Reports on MCWD, CY 2019-2024 (MCWD_COA_Record_2014-2024)

jva.continuous: Provision of Continuous Water Supply to all connected Consumers
jva.penalty: If PrimeWater misses a service obligation, the district may forfeit 6% of its performance bond (Sec. 5.1.9), after a written notice and 60 days to cure (Sec. 5.3.3).
jva.kpiGap: None of the six targets the district checks measures hours of supply or pressure, though continuous supply is one of the seven service obligations.
jva.cite: COA Annual Audit Reports on MCWD, CY2022 Obs. 7 and CY2024 Obs. 6, quoting JVA Sec. 5
jva.notPublic: The full agreement is not public. In August 2025 the mayor asked PrimeWater for a copy for the city council; the request had not been met (SunStar Pampanga, 14 Aug 2025).
